In Roth accounts its similar you can just freely swap from growth funds to these income funds near retirement. Once you hit the age limit for Roth accounts I plan to just start yield maxxing there.
In taxable accounts these income funds have tax drag which means it's usually still better to eat the long term tax after retirement to switch from growth to income funds. Spread it out over a few years for tax avoidance maxxing.
